description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex, email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex; existing capability snapshot owner
Add verified SMTP attachment preparation/submission and exact encoded-size checks using current shared settings.file_delivery. Select actual outbound SMTP connection even for IMAP-origin replies and freeze sender/config/requirements. Advertise file support and send_with_attachments only with working implementation. Preserve existing UI and shared validation; no old SMTP-specific settings import.

Tests to add before implementation: MIME size boundaries, configured count, absent required values, prepared display metadata, IMAP-to-selected-SMTP identity, sender isolation, thread headers, prepare-all-before-submit, partial submissions.

Branches/paths validated: MIME size boundaries, configured count, absent required values, prepared display metadata, IMAP-to-selected-SMTP identity, sender isolation, thread headers, prepare-all-before-submit, partial submissions.

Action reuse assessment: Extend existing SmtpSender and EmailBridge; reuse shared FileSettings and TransportRequirements. SMTP is transport infrastructure, not a new Action. Existing email history/notification ownership remains.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.
title: [zaq-6rc.6] Integrate SMTP preparation and delivery
